previous_statement: For a C^1 manifold M (called a class-one manifold in GT-cairns-1935-theorem-p549), the domains of the allowable coordinate systems in its atlas are open subsets of M whose union is M.
new_statement: For a C^1 manifold M and any atlas A defining its manifold structure, every chart domain in A is an open subset of M and the union of all chart domains in A is M.
